about_the_game:
MUDBIRD is an adventure survival game about exploring a mysterious archipelago. Use the few sticks and leaves you have at your disposal to make it through the cold days and escape! A cozy and atmospheric spring experience. 

a few features:

  • survive on a desolate island in early spring!

  • interact with a whole cast of NPCs and ghosts!

  • repair grandpa's old canoe to explore a set of islands

  • save up your hard-earned cash to escape the archipelago and head home!

  • go spearfishing, take care of your tulip garden, tend to the fire

  • use your binoculars to discover the birds of the islands

  • explore a mysterious underground cave

  • send a message in a bottle to other players on their own islands!

  • 2d top-down hand-drawn pixelart graphics

  • relax and watch the snow fall
